name: skillproof-monorepo
description: AI + Blockchain Hiring Trust Platform - Monorepo

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd packages/frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd packages/backend && npm run start:dev
scripts.dev:ai: node init && cd packages/ai-service && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload
scripts.dev:no-ai: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build:frontend: node init && cd packages/frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: node init && cd packages/backend && npm run build
